title: 0218 - L3 PATH COMPLETION of the owner's loom/full-tail idea (OFF-BOARD, no RH claim): all 8 named branches now executed - (L2D) zero-origin cuts (813 zeros 0-1200, dec20): a ZERO as origin is NOT privileged - same lane predictability as prime-origin in the same band (M1 0.1476 vs 0.1225, within ~1 SE; due-lane 0.1119 vs 0.1275): zeros add no EXTRA memory (consistent with the 0214 t-flat hole); (LJ) joint pointing = predicted lane x survivor field compresses the ~37-43-survivor W=500 field to a 5-6 candidate set with the next prime as its head 21.9% (1 lane) / 39.8% (top-2 lanes), 2.13 nats/window certainty gain - the POINTING power is carried by the lane law (0.22), the field supplies the candidate list; (L4K) progression ladder: NO strong unconditional long-range pattern (ordered K-tuple top-1 decays monotonically 0.1252/0.0278/0.0062/0.0016 for K=1-4; top patterns are twin-type: [13,17], [1,5,7,11]) - the 'pattern' is LOCAL (context-conditional gap law + due-lane), not a free-riding sequence statistic; (L1b) BLOOM(24) scale: the front bloom DECAYS with X (mean|f(c)-f(c+12)| 0.07315 @2e6 -> 0.06493 @1e7 -> 0.05602 @1e8; gap~6/gap~18 ratio 2.68->2.39->2.11) = an LO-type SLOW bias, not fixed sieve geometry; (LM1) the model discriminator first cut (X=2e6 A6 word): REAL H_m = 1.52391/1.41279/1.35063+/-0.009 sits BELOW EVERY FLOOR - Cramer iid 1.751 (no memory), pair-law order-1 chain H3 1.52268, order-2 law chain H3 1.41727 - real H3 is ~7 block-SE below the order-2 floor: the loom tension is a GENUINE DEEPER WEAVE that exceeds even the two-gap law at this resolution (BOOM-for-real candidate); the FINAL adjudication remains named: LOOM-1b2 = full Landau-Lodsmann/LO k-consecutive-gap joint-law simulation vs the real H_m ladder (LD matches => loom IS the sieve / subsumed 0098; real < LD => excess structure / new object); encoding bug found+fixed in the L4K measurement (base-8 ordered code had silently equated to the multiset sum - first cut K=2 top-1 0.1492 was an artifact; corrected ladder 0.1252/0.0278/0.0062/0.0016)
body: Owner's question (0218): 'wait, did we explore the whole path for my idea or is that just a preliminary report?' - honest answer: 0216/0217 were a preliminary report (3 of 8 branches: LOOM-0, L2A, L2B, L2C); this entry executes the remainder. All work off-board, no RH claim, single-threaded (4 cores open), reproducible (scripts/sq/loom3_path_completion.py + fix-up re-runs loom3_lm1_only.py, loom3_l4k_only.py; output tmp/loom/loom3_out.txt; doc section 'L3 (0218): PATH COMPLETION' in docs/LOOM-PENROSE-SIDE-QUEST-2026-10-29.md). (L2D ZERO-ORIGIN - the 'or zeta zero' half of the owner's original sentence) 813 certified zeros 0<=gamma<=1200 (scripts/rh/lowt/zeros_0_to_1p2e3.dec20.txt, dec20) as origins; tail = all primes <= gamma (height scale, the 0909/0214 machine); target = the LANE (mod-24 class, 8 reduced lanes) of the first prime above gamma; models M1 (order-1 lane Markov trained at 1e7) and M3 (due-lane: the lane that waited longest across the whole tail); band-matched prime-origin baseline in the same 14-1200 band (n=204 cuts). Results: zero-origin n=813: M1 top-1 = 0.1476 (mean logLik -2.19287), due-lane top-1 = 0.1119; prime-origin n=204: M1 top-1 = 0.1225 (mean logLik -2.16651), due-lane = 0.1275. Splits within ~1 SE in both columns (SE(0.125, n=813)=0.0116; n=204 -> 0.0237): a zero as origin is NOT a privileged origin - it carries the SAME lane predictability as a prime. Prediction power comes from the local gap law (context), not the TYPE of origin; the zeros add no extra memory (consistent with the 0214 C1 finding that the antipode hole was t-flat at zero heights - 816 zeros, no sensitivity). The low absolute rates (0.12-0.15 vs 0.2205 at 1e7) are the tiny 14-1200 band (small-X weak gap law), not a method failure. (LJ JOINT POINTING - 'point to the next prime' as one number) predicted lane (M1 argmax) + top-2-lane variant, intersected with the survivor field S_y = {m in (N, N+500]: no prime factor <= y} (y = 541, 1223); candidate set C = S_y restricted to the predicted lane(s); all 654,986 cuts. Results: y=541: |S| = 43.51, |C1| = 5.48, first-candidate == next prime 0.2168, |C2| = 11.00, hit 0.3823, position-certainty gain ln|S|-ln|C1| = 2.12 nats/window, P(|C1|<=2 | nonempty) = 0.0313; y=1223: |S| = 37.05, |C1| = 4.67, hit 0.2190, |C2| = 9.37, hit 0.3975, gain 2.14 nats, P(|C1|<=2) = 0.0859. The joint machine compresses the raw field ~8x (37-43 -> 5-6 candidates) and the next prime heads that set 21.9% (1 lane) / 39.8% (top-2 lanes) of the time. The 21.9% tracks the standalone lane top-1 (0.2205, L2A): the POINTING power is carried by the lane law; the sieve field supplies the candidate list (it rarely eliminates the lane's first candidate: survivors are dense). That is the honest, decomposed form of the owner's 'link the many primes in the history to the future prediction field and what is allowed through'. (L4K PROGRESSION LADDER - 'the harmony or progression that informs us of the pattern', beyond the single next prime) UNCONDITIONAL (no context) frequency of the next K lanes as an ordered K-tuple vs an order-free (multiset) K-lane composition, K = 1..4, all cuts. Corrected results (A BASE-8 ENCODING BUG WAS FOUND AND FIXED WHILE MEASURING: the first cut's ordered code skipped the most-significant column and silently equated the 'ordered' frequency with the multiset sum, producing the impossible K=2 top-1 0.1492 > K=1 0.1252; the corrected ladder): K=1 ordered 0.1252 (top lane 23), K=2 ordered 0.0278 (top pattern [13,17] = twin-type +4), K=3 ordered 0.0062 ([13,17,23]), K=4 ordered 0.0016 ([1,5,7,11]); top-3 unions 0.3753/0.0832/0.0183/0.0045; multiset (out-of-order) top-1 0.1252/0.0389/0.0175/0.0101. Monotone decay => NO strong unconditional long-range pattern: the 'progression' is LOCAL (context-conditional: the one-step gap law 0.22 + the weak whole-tail due-lane 0.155, L2A), not a free-riding sequence statistic; the order-free multiset is only slightly better than the ordered tuple at K=3,4 (composition is a touch more predictable than order). Top patterns are small-gap/twin-type progressions, consistent with BLOOM-24 (0216). (L1b BLOOM SCALE - does the 24-adic front bloom decay or is it fixed?) mean|f(c)-f(c+12)| over the six even antipode pairs (mod 24): X=2e6 (0216): 0.07315; X=1e7: 0.06493 (gap~2 0.11064/0.06096 r1.815; gap~4 0.11069/0.04674 r2.368; gap~6 0.18739/0.07848 r2.388; gap~8 0.07520/0.03802 r1.978; gap~10 0.09377/0.03362 r2.789; gap~12 0.11710/0.04739 r2.471); X=1e8: 0.05602 (gap~6 r2.105, gap~10 r2.410, gap~4 r2.070, gap~2 r1.667, gap~8 r1.724, gap~12 r2.159). The front bloom DECAYS MONOTONELY over two decades (0.073 -> 0.065 -> 0.056; every individual pair ratio decays): it is an LO-type SLOW bias (same family as the mod-4 gap bias 0196), NOT immutable sieve geometry. The exact decay form (ln X / ln ln X / power) to be fitted = feeds LOOM-1b2. (LM1 MODEL DISCRIMINATOR - LOOM-1 first cut, X = 2e6, the A6 = gap/2 mod 6 word, 1.489e5 symbols) H_m (per-symbol entropy, Markov fit, 8-block SE): REAL: H0 = 1.75033, H1 = 1.52391+/-0.01022, H2 = 1.41279+/-0.00954, H3 = 1.35063+/-0.00925. FLOOR-0 (Cramer iid at the empirical marginal, 5 chains): H1 = 1.75107, H2 = 1.74921 (no memory by construction). FLOOR-1 (pair law: order-1 Markov chain generated from the fitted 6x6 transition; 5 chains of 2e6): generated H3 = 1.52268 (~ its H1, as an order-1 process must). FLOOR-2 (order-2 law: chain generated from the fitted 6x6x6; 5 chains): generated H3 = 1.41727 (~ its H2). VERDICT: the real H_m ladder sits BELOW EVERY FLOOR, and each added memory order captures real structure (deltas 0.227/0.111/0.062, all >> block-SE). Real H3 (1.3506) is ~7.2 block-SE BELOW the order-2-law floor (1.4173): the loom tension EXCEEDS even the two-gap law - a GENUINE DEEPER 24-ADIC WEAVE at this resolution (a BOOM-for-real candidate). CAVEAT (the honest boundary): the pair law and order-2 law here are EMPIRICAL Markov fits, not the Landau-Lodsmann/LO THEORETICAL prediction; the actual sieve heuristic predicts the FULL k-consecutive-gap joint law (with k-th order correlations), so 'deeper than pair/order-2 fits' is NOT yet 'deeper than the sieve law'. The final subsumed-vs-boom adjudication = LOOM-1b2: simulate the LD/LO k-tuple joint generator at X=2e6/1e7 and compare its H_m ladder to the real one. If LD matches the real H_m: the loom IS the sieve (subsumed - the 0098 Euler-action verdict, a beautiful end-state). If real < LD: excess structure beyond every known law (a genuinely new object - the loom is more than the sieve). PATH-COMPLETE STATUS: all eight named branches of the owner's idea are now executed (LOOM-0 0216; L2A/L2B/L2C 0217; L2D/LJ/L4K/L1b/LM1-first-cut 0218) or named with a stated deferral reason (L2B' controlled content-at-fixed-phase, L2C' long window ladder W=1e3/1e4, LOOM-1b2 the LD-generator adjudication + bloom decay-form fit, LOOM-2 sieve-as-substitution formalization, wheel-loom cross-test [deferred because the 0214 hole is t-flat: no prediction channel from the hole]). Bug log (0218): (1) L4K base-8 ordered encoding skipped the most-significant column (ordered==multiset artifact, K=2 0.1492 impossible) - fixed, re-run standalone (loom3_l4k_only.py); (2) np.cumsum(P) on the (6,6) transition matrix flattened to (36,) making searchsorted 0-dim - fixed with axis=1 (hit both floor generators; the first LM1 run crashed on it); (3) gen_chain_order1 needed a per-run seed (5 chains were identical) - fixed. No RH claim anywhere in this entry or its artifacts; the side quest remains off the critical path (B6 watcher still the board lane; U3c(j) the analytic lane).
